info.title: Alien Farm Auction V1 account-authenticated Mock API
info.description: Standalone Node/Fastify/SQLite market: shared listings, persistent server userId-owned wallets and inventory; tokens are revocable opaque account_sessions. Auction listing expiry returns unsold Lots to server inventory. No legacy guest authentication or cloud-save transport. Google and Steam support sign-in/link when configured. This does not grant access to unverified real game assets. ACH-01/02/03: independent server-only achievement config, account-owned exact progress, and once-only aggregate game-event POST. No gameplay bridge or tradable drop issuance. PROFILE-01~06: userId-owned player profiles, trusted provider-verified email records and self-service nickname/avatar editing.

post.summary: Submit memory-aggregated gameplay facts; no client replay or tradable asset issuance
post.description: Authenticated by Session with permanent server-derived userId. Client-completed actions may trigger server-side configurable item lotteries; the server does not verify actual farming/mining, by explicit product choice. Aggregates preserve sourceActionIds and per-source categories. One player action is one independent trial per matching reward rule, regardless of amount U or number of field cells. One account-wide server-clock cooldown starts only when any rule wins (default 86400 seconds, configurable/disableable); actions skipped during cooldown are permanently marked, not delayed. Independent rules in the same action can win together. Winning items are created by the server in the existing trade station inventory atomically with lottery and cooldown receipts, without auto-listing. Client cannot specify prize, probability or win result. Offline failures are never retried; auction.sold is internal server-only.

get.description: Return latest CONFIRMED delivery sequence as the minimum allowed watermark for local Save recovery, plus any single pending delivery reservation.

post.description: Subtract allowed server-manufactured stock atomically and reserve one PENDING lot per userId+worldId. Retry the SAME key after ambiguous network outcome. No client claim can issue additional server stock.

409.description: Pending delivery or insufficient server goods

422.description: Invalid item, quantity or idempotency key

post.description: Marks a PENDING delivery CONFIRMED after client-reported committed Save. The authenticated account and world must own this delivery. Does not automatically issue goods in Worker; never claims server verification of local IndexedDB Save. Confirmed sequence blocks older local save recoveries.
